Pdf._comment: UseHtmlRenderer=true renders document PDFs with a headless Chromium-family browser so the download matches the HTML preview exactly. On Windows, set ExecutablePath to the installed Edge to avoid any download, e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe. If left empty, PuppeteerSharp downloads Chromium into BrowserCachePath (set this to a folder the app/IIS identity can write). When UseHtmlRenderer=false (default) or the browser is unavailable, PDFs use QuestPDF.

Enforcement._comment: Kill-switch สำหรับ readonly-after-expiry + company-suspend (WP-A1/A2). Off = ไม่ทำอะไร, LogOnly = log อย่างเดียวปล่อยผ่าน (default ปลอดภัย ทยอยเปิด), Enforce = บล็อก write จริง. เปลี่ยนเป็น Enforce หลัง monitor log 1-2 สัปดาห์.

Jwt._comment: REQUIRED: Set JWT_SECRET environment variable in production!

Security._comment: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY env var for encrypting sensitive DB fields

Portal._comment: Set PORTAL_SIGNING_KEY env var in production

Bot._comment: Register at portal.api.bot.or.th for API key (free)

Ocr._comment: OCR provider chain: Azure DI v4 (cloud, primary if configured) → Local microservice (PaddleOCR + EasyOCR ensemble, fallback). Other settings configurable via Admin UI override these defaults.

Captcha._comment: hCaptcha or reCAPTCHA secret key. Site key is stored per-site in CMS settings.
